title: PCC fines MVP-linked firms P5.8M for late merger reports

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two companies linked to tycoon Manuel V. Pangilinan received a P5.8-million fine for repeatedly missing the reporting deadlines that the Philippine Competition Commission (PCC) imposed as part of a merger clearance. According to the antitrust watchdog, it found Pilipinas Enterprise Management Holdings Inc. (PEMHI) and Meralco PowerGen Corp. (MGen) liable for violating the Philippine Competition Act after failing to submit required reports on time for three consecutive quarters in 2025. READ: PCC restores 30-day deadline for merger filings PEMHI is MGen’s ultimate parent company, the power-generation arm of Pangilinan-led Manila Electric Co. (Meralco).
